src_text: "Gwo non touye ti chen" (Big names can crush the little guy)

translation.src_text: Rad pa janm fè moun.
translation.tgt_text: Clothes do not make a person.

src_text: "Rad pa janm fè moun." (Clothes never make the person.)

translation.src_text: Rad sal lave nan fanmi.
translation.tgt_text: Dirty clothes are [to be] washed in the family.

src_text: "Rad sal lave nan fanmi." (Family matters are handled within the family.)

translation.src_text: Rann sèvis mennen chagren.
translation.tgt_text: To give a hand leads to sorrow.

src_text: Rann sèvis mennen chagren. (Doing favors can bring trouble.)

translation.src_text: Rat anpil, trou pa fon.
translation.tgt_text: Lots of rats, the hole is not deep.

src_text: "Rat anpil, trou pa fon." (Too many rats, and the hole isn’t deep enough.)

translation.src_text: Rat konnen chat konnen barik mayi-a rete la.
translation.tgt_text: The rat knows, the cat knows: the corn barrel is safe.

src_text: "Rat konnen chat konnen barik mayi-a rete la." (When both sides know what’s going on, the corn barrel stays put.)

translation.src_text: Rat mode, souffle
translation.tgt_text: Rats bite then blow.

src_text: "Rat mode, souffle" (When the rat is hungry, it blows on the food to cool it down.)

translation.src_text: Rayi chen an, men di dan li blanch.
translation.tgt_text: [You may] hate the dog, but [you must] admit that its teeth are white.

src_text: Rayi chen an, men di dan li blanch. (You may dislike the dog, but you still have to admit its teeth are white.)

translation.src_text: Rebwè se nòs.
translation.tgt_text: Drinking again is [like] a wedding.

src_text: "Rebwè se nòs." (Drinking again is like a wedding celebration.)

translation.src_text: Regle jis pa gate zanmi.
translation.tgt_text: A fair deal does not spoil friendship.

src_text: Regle jis pa gate zanmi. (Settle things fairly so you don’t ruin friendships.)

translation.src_text: Responsab se chay.
translation.tgt_text: [To be] responsible is a load.

src_text: "Responsab se chay." (Being responsible is a burden.)

translation.src_text: Sa je pa wè, kè pa tounen.
translation.tgt_text: What you don’t know can’t hurt you.

src_text: Sa je pa wè, kè pa tounen. (What the eye does not see, the heart does not ache over.)

translation.src_text: Sa ki rete nan kè-m dòmi lakay.
translation.tgt_text: What is still in my heart sleeps at my home.

src_text: Sa ki rete nan kè-m dòmi lakay. (What stays in my heart sleeps at home.)

translation.src_text: Sa ou pa konnen pi gran pase ou.
translation.tgt_text: What you do not know is bigger than you.

src_text: Sa ou pa konnen pi gran pase ou. (What you don’t know can be greater than you.)

translation.src_text: Sa ou t’ap chache antè, ou jwenn li atè.
translation.tgt_text: What you are searching underground, you find it on the ground.

src_text: Sa ou t’ap chache antè, ou jwenn li atè. (What you were looking for up above, you found right on the ground.)

translation.src_text: Sa-k pase nan kizin, lakay pa bezwen konnen.
translation.tgt_text: What goes on in the kitchen, the house does not need to know.

src_text: Sa-k pase nan kizin, lakay pa bezwen konnen. (What happens in the kitchen doesn’t need to be known at home.)

translation.src_text: Sak vid pa kanpe.
translation.tgt_text: An empty sack cannot stand up.

src_text: Sak vid pa kanpe. (An empty sack can’t stand up.)

translation.src_text: Se aprè batay nou konte blese.
translation.tgt_text: It is after the battle that you count the injured.

src_text: Se aprè batay nou konte blese. (It’s after the fight that we count the wounds.)

translation.src_text: Se chat kay k’ap manje poul kay.
translation.tgt_text: It is the cat of the house that will eat the hen of the house.

src_text: Se chat kay k’ap manje poul kay. (It’s the house cat that’s eating the chickens in the house.)

translation.src_text: Se de bon ki fè bonbon.
translation.tgt_text: It’s two ‘good’ that makes candy.

src_text: Se de bon ki fè bonbon. (It takes two good things to make something truly good.)

translation.src_text: Se grès kochon an ki kwit kochon an.
translation.tgt_text: It is the pork’s grease that cooks the pork.

src_text: "Se grès kochon an ki kwit kochon an." (It’s the pig’s own fat that cooks the pig.)

translation.src_text: Se kouto sèlman ki konnen sa ki nan kè yanm.
translation.tgt_text: Only the knife knows what is in the yam’s heart.

src_text: Se kouto sèlman ki konnen sa ki nan kè yanm. (Only the knife knows what’s inside the yam.)

translation.src_text: Se lakizin ki di-m ki jan lakay ye.
translation.tgt_text: It is the kitchen that tells me how the house is.

src_text: Se lakizin ki di-m ki jan lakay ye. (The kitchen tells me what home is like.)

translation.src_text: Se lè koulèv mouri ou wè longè-l.
translation.tgt_text: It is when the snake dies that you can see its size.

src_text: Se lè koulèv mouri ou wè longè-l. (You only realize how long the snake is after it’s dead.)

translation.src_text: Sè lè van soufle ou wè dèyè poul.
translation.tgt_text: It is when the wind blows that you can see the hen’s behind.

src_text: Sè lè van soufle ou wè dèyè poul. (Only when the wind blows do you see the back of a chicken.)

translation.src_text: Se mèt kò ki veye kò.
translation.tgt_text: It is the owner of the body who watches his body.

src_text: Se mèt kò ki veye kò. (You have to look out for yourself.)

translation.src_text: Se nan chemen ou konnen sa-k pase nan chanm.
translation.tgt_text: It is on the road that you learn what goes on in [your] room.

src_text: Se nan chemen ou konnen sa-k pase nan chanm. (You only really know what happens in a room by being on the path that leads there.)

translation.src_text: Se nan chemiz blanch yo wè tach
translation.tgt_text: It is on the white shirt that one can see the stain.

src_text: Se nan chemiz blanch yo wè tach (It’s on a white shirt that stains are most visible).

translation.src_text: Se pa nèg ki voye wòch ki te tiye koulèv-la, se nèg ki te wè’l
translation.tgt_text: It is not the man who threw the stone who killed the snake: it is the man who saw it.

src_text: Se pa nèg ki voye wòch ki te tiye koulèv-la, se nèg ki te wè’l (It wasn’t the person who threw the stone that killed the snake, it was the one who saw it.)

translation.src_text: Se siro ki rale foumi.
translation.tgt_text: It is the syrup that attract ants.

src_text: "Se siro ki rale foumi." (It’s the syrup that attracts the ants.)

translation.src_text: Se sou pye mango chaje yo voye wòch.
translation.tgt_text: It is on the mango tree full of fruits that they throw stones.

src_text: Se sou pye mango chaje yo voye wòch. (It’s the mango tree loaded with fruit that gets pelted with stones.)

translation.src_text: Se soulye ki konn si chosèt gen twou.
translation.tgt_text: It is the shoe that knows if the sock has a hole.

src_text: "Se soulye ki konn si chosèt gen twou." (Only the shoes know whether the socks have holes.)

translation.src_text: Si bòt la tro jis pou ou, mache pye atè.
translation.tgt_text: If your boot is too tight, walk barefoot.

src_text: Si bòt la tro jis pou ou, mache pye atè. (If the shoe is too tight for you, walk barefoot.)

translation.src_text: Si m’te konnen toujou dèyè.
translation.tgt_text: ‘If I had known’ is always behind.

src_text: Si m’te konnen toujou dèyè. (If I had known, I would have stayed behind.)

translation.src_text: Si ou gen yon sous k’ap ba ou dlo, ou pa koupe pyebwa kote-l.
translation.tgt_text: If you have a well that can give you water, you must not cut the tree near it.

src_text: Si ou gen yon sous k’ap ba ou dlo, ou pa koupe pyebwa kote-l. (If you have a spring that gives you water, you don’t cut down the tree where it comes from.)

translation.src_text: Si ou kouvri dife, w’ap gen dife.
translation.tgt_text: If you cover a fire, you [still] have a fire.

src_text: Si ou kouvri dife, w’ap gen dife. (If you cover up fire, you’ll still have fire.)

translation.src_text: Si ou manje bouji, fòk ou poupou mèch.
translation.tgt_text: If you eat a candle, you must poop the wick.

src_text: Si ou manje bouji, fòk ou poupou mèch. (If you eat a candle, you’ve got to poop out the wick.)

translation.src_text: Si ou vle gen rezon devan kras, se benyen p’ou benyen.
translation.tgt_text: If you want to win over dirt, you need to bathe [thoroughly].

src_text: Si ou vle gen rezon devan kras, se benyen p’ou benyen. (If you want to be right in front of a dirty person, you have to get in the water too.)

translation.src_text: Sòt pa touye-w, men li fè ou swe.
translation.tgt_text: Stupid does not kill you, but it makes you sweat.

src_text: Sòt pa touye-w, men li fè ou swe. (Foolishness won’t kill you, but it’ll make you sweat.)

translation.src_text: Souke tèt pa kase kou.
translation.tgt_text: To shake the head won't break the neck.

src_text: "Souke tèt pa kase kou." (A little shaking of the head won’t break the neck.)

translation.src_text: Tan ale, li pa tounen.
translation.tgt_text: Time goes, but does not come back.

src_text: Tan ale, li pa tounen. (Time passes, and it never comes back.)

translation.src_text: Tande ak wè se de.
translation.tgt_text: To hear and to see are two [different] things.

src_text: Tande ak wè se de. (Hearing and seeing are two different things.)

translation.src_text: Tande pa di konprann pou sa.
translation.tgt_text: To hear does not mean to understand.

src_text: Tande pa di konprann pou sa. (Hearing something doesn’t mean you understand it.)

translation.src_text: Tete pa janm twò lou pou mèt li.
translation.tgt_text: Breasts are never heavy for their owner.

src_text: "Tete pa janm twò lou pou mèt li." (A burden is never too heavy for the one who carries it.)

translation.src_text: Ti bwa ou pa wè, se li ka pete je-w.
translation.tgt_text: The small stick you do not see is the one that may puncture your eye.

src_text: "Ti bwa ou pa wè, se li ka pete je-w." (The small stick you don’t notice can be the one that pokes your eye.)

translation.src_text: Ti chen gen fòs sèlman devan kay mèt li.
translation.tgt_text: A puppy is strong only before his master’s house.

src_text: Ti chen gen fòs sèlman devan kay mèt li. (A small dog only acts tough in front of its owner’s house.)

translation.src_text: Ti kou ti kou bay lanmò.
translation.tgt_text: Light blows [again and again] bring death.

src_text: "Ti kou ti kou bay lanmò." (Little by little, small blows can bring death.)

translation.src_text: Ti koulèv k’ap grandi se anba wòch ke li rete.
translation.tgt_text: Little snakes need to grow in hiding.

src_text: "Ti koulèv k’ap grandi se anba wòch ke li rete." (A little snake that is growing stays under a rock.)

translation.src_text: Ti kouri kenbe tete; gwo kouri, lage tete.
translation.tgt_text: For a little run, hold your breast; for a big run, don’t hold your breast.

src_text: "Ti kouri kenbe tete; gwo kouri, lage tete." (A little run keeps the breast; a big run makes you let go of the breast.)

translation.src_text: Ti mapou pa grandi anba gwo mapou.
translation.tgt_text: Little ‘mapou’ [big tree highly respected in Haiti] do not grow at the foot of big ‘mapou’.

src_text: "Ti mapou pa grandi anba gwo mapou." (A small sapling can’t grow under a big tree.)

translation.src_text: Ti pil ti pil fè chaj.
translation.tgt_text: A little amount plus a little amount make a load.

src_text: "Ti pil ti pil fè chaj." (Little by little, it adds up.)

translation.src_text: Toro ki begle pa gra.
translation.tgt_text: The bull that lows is not fat.

src_text: "Toro ki begle pa gra." (A bull that keeps bellowing isn’t fat.)

translation.src_text: Twou bounda’w won… ou bizwen pete kare.
translation.tgt_text: Your anus is round… you [need to] fart square.

src_text: Twou bounda’w won… ou bizwen pete kare. (When your backside is round, you need to break it open square.)

translation.src_text: Toujou gen retay kay tayè.
translation.tgt_text: [There are] always leftovers at the tailor’s house.

src_text: Toujou gen retay kay tayè. (There’s always something left unfinished, even at the tailor’s house.)

translation.src_text: Tout bèt jennen mòde.
translation.tgt_text: Any strain animal [will] bite.

src_text: "Tout bèt jennen mòde." (Any cornered animal will bite.)

translation.src_text: Tout moun se moun, tout moun pa menm.
translation.tgt_text: All people are people but not all people are the same.

src_text: "Tout moun se moun, tout moun pa menm." (Everyone is human, but not everyone is the same.)

translation.src_text: Two prese fè ou bo sou nen.
translation.tgt_text: Too much hurry makes you kiss the nose.

src_text: "Two prese fè ou bo sou nen." (Rushing makes you kiss someone on the nose.)

translation.src_text: Two vit pa rive.
translation.tgt_text: Too fast does not arrive.

src_text: "Two vit pa rive." (Haste makes waste.)

translation.src_text: Vant plen pa gwòs; gwo tèt pa lespri.
translation.tgt_text: A big belly does not mean pregnancy; a big head does not mean wits.

src_text: "Vant plen pa gwòs; gwo tèt pa lespri." (A full belly doesn’t mean you’re fat; a big head doesn’t mean you’re wise.)

translation.src_text: Volè pa janm renmen volè parey li.
translation.tgt_text: A thief never likes a thief like him.

src_text: "Volè pa janm renmen volè parey li." (Thieves never like their own kind.)

translation.src_text: Vwazinaj se fanmi
translation.tgt_text: Neighborhood is family.

src_text: Vwazinaj se fanmi (neighbors are like family)

translation.src_text: Wè jodi-a, men sonje denmen.
translation.tgt_text: See (live) today, but think about tomorrow.

src_text: Wè jodi-a, men sonje denmen. (Live for today, but remember tomorrow.)

translation.src_text: Wè pa wè, lantèman pou katrè.
translation.tgt_text: See [it] or not, the funeral is at four o’clock.

src_text: Wè pa wè, lantèman pou katrè. (Whether you see it or not, the funeral is at four.)

translation.src_text: Wòch nan dlo pa konn doulè wòch nan soley.
translation.tgt_text: The stone in the water does not know the pain of the stone in the sun.

src_text: Wòch nan dlo pa konn doulè wòch nan soley. (A stone in water doesn’t know the pain of a stone in the sun.)

translation.src_text: Wont pi lou pase sak sèl.
translation.tgt_text: Shame is heavier than a bag of salt.

src_text: "Wont pi lou pase sak sèl." (Shame weighs heavier than a sack of salt.)

translation.src_text: Yo pa achte chat nan sak.
translation.tgt_text: You don’t buy a cat in a bag. (Make sure you know what you are buying.)

src_text: Yo pa achte chat nan sak. (Don’t buy a cat in a bag.)

translation.src_text: Yo pa voye wòch sou mango vèt.
translation.tgt_text: You don’t throw rocks at a green mango. (You wait until a mango is ripe before you try to knock it down from the tree.)

src_text: Yo pa voye wòch sou mango vèt. (People don’t throw stones at green mangoes.)

translation.src_text: Yon bon zanmi pi bon pase frè.
translation.tgt_text: A good friend is better than a brother.

src_text: Yon bon zanmi pi bon pase frè. (A good friend is better than a brother.)

translation.src_text: Yon jou pou chasè, yon jou pou jibye
translation.tgt_text: The hunter has his day, but the prey has his day as well“

src_text: Yon jou pou chasè, yon jou pou jibye (one day you’re the hunter, the next day you’re the hunted)

translation.src_text: Zafè kabrit pa zafè mouton.
translation.tgt_text: The goat’s business is not the sheep’s business.

src_text: Zafè kabrit pa zafè mouton. (A goat’s business is not a sheep’s business.)

translation.src_text: Zanmi prè se kouto de bo; zanmi lwen se lajan sere.
translation.tgt_text: Close friends are [like] a double-edge knife; far away friends are saved money.

src_text: "Zanmi prè se kouto de bo; zanmi lwen se lajan sere." (A close friend can be a double-edged knife; a distant friend is like money saved.)

translation.src_text: Zanno kase nan sak, grenn li pa pèdi.
translation.tgt_text: [When] the necklace [is] broken in a bag, its pieces are not lost.

src_text: "Zanno kase nan sak, grenn li pa pèdi." (Even if the earring breaks in the bag, its beads are not lost.)

translation.src_text: Ze ki kale tro bonè, ti poul la p’ap viv.
translation.tgt_text: [When] eggs hatch too early, chickens will not live.

src_text: "Ze ki kale tro bonè, ti poul la p’ap viv." (A chick that hatches too early won’t survive.)

translation.src_text: "Je pa wè, kè pa tounen."
translation.tgt_text: Far from the eyes, far from the heart

src_text: Je pa wè, kè pa tounen. (Out of sight, out of mind.)

translation.src_text: Ou achte kochon pou ras.
translation.tgt_text: You buy the pig for its breed/race.

src_text: Ou achte kochon pou ras. (You buy a pig for breeding.)

translation.src_text: Nan mitan avèg, bòy se wa
translation.tgt_text: Bad is better than worse.

src_text: Nan mitan avèg, bòy se wa (among the blind, the one-eyed man is king)

translation.src_text: Ou ka twonpe cheve, ou pa twonpe bab.
translation.tgt_text: You can fool the young and inexperienced, but not the old bearded.

src_text: Ou ka twonpe cheve, ou pa twonpe bab. (You can fool the hair, but you can’t fool the beard.)

translation.src_text: Bèf ki bèf pran souf.
translation.tgt_text: Even the ox takes a break

src_text: "Bèf ki bèf pran souf." (Even the strongest ox needs a breather.)

translation.src_text: Dan ri malè.
translation.tgt_text: Teeth laugh at misfortune

src_text: Dan ri malè. (A smile can hide trouble.)

translation.src_text: Dan ri danje.
translation.tgt_text: Teeth laugh at misfortune

src_text: "Dan ri danje." (Laughing can be dangerous.)

translation.src_text: Vant pa gadmanje
translation.tgt_text: Don't overload your stomach

src_text: "Vant pa gadmanje" (A belly is not a pantry)

translation.src_text: Veye kò ou pou ou pa pile si m te konnen.
translation.tgt_text: Be careful in the face of a lurking threat

src_text: Veye kò ou pou ou pa pile si m te konnen. (Watch your step so you don’t end up saying, “If only I had known.”)

translation.src_text: Regleman pa gate zanmitay.
translation.tgt_text: Setting up doesn't spoil friends/friendship.

src_text: Regleman pa gate zanmitay. (Rules don’t ruin friendship.)

translation.src_text: Etranje miyò pase fanmi.
translation.tgt_text: Sometimes strangers treat you better than your own family

src_text: "Etranje miyò pase fanmi." (Sometimes strangers are better than family.)

translation.src_text: Tande bèf, ale wè kòn
translation.tgt_text: Just talk!

src_text: Tande bèf, ale wè kòn (hear the cow, go see the horns)

translation.src_text: Tanga pi rèd pase rad.
translation.tgt_text: Old clothes are better than Sunday best.

src_text: Tanga pi rèd pase rad. (A person’s skin is tougher than their clothes.)

translation.src_text: Tan ranje tout bagay
translation.tgt_text: Time heals all wounds.

src_text: Tan ranje tout bagay (Time fixes everything)

translation.src_text: Tanga prete pa kouvri fredi
translation.tgt_text: Old borrowed clothes don't protect against the cold

src_text: Tanga prete pa kouvri fredi (Borrowed clothes don’t keep you warm).

translation.src_text: Timoun chich kriye de vwa
translation.tgt_text: The stingy child cries twice

src_text: Timoun chich kriye de vwa (A stingy child cries in two voices)

translation.src_text: Kabrit pa mare nan pikèt bèf.
translation.tgt_text: Don't tie the goat on the ox's stake

src_text: "Kabrit pa mare nan pikèt bèf." (A goat shouldn’t be tied to a cow’s stake.)

translation.src_text: Pa chache lè ou pa mete.
translation.tgt_text: Don't ask for what you didn't earn

src_text: Pa chache lè ou pa mete. (Don’t expect to reap what you didn’t sow.)

translation.src_text: Pa fouye zo nan kalalou.
translation.tgt_text: Don't go looking for trouble

src_text: Pa fouye zo nan kalalou. (Don’t go digging for trouble.)

translation.src_text: Pa fè m sa m pap fè ou
translation.tgt_text: Don't do to me what I wouldn't do to you

src_text: Pa fè m sa m pap fè ou (Don’t do to me what I won’t do to you)

translation.src_text: Pise gaye pa fè kim
translation.tgt_text: A rolling stone gathers no moss

src_text: Pise gaye pa fè kim (Scattered stepping doesn’t make foam).

translation.src_text: Pa fè dyab pi nwè pase li ye.
translation.tgt_text: Don't exaggerate.

src_text: Pa fè dyab pi nwè pase li ye. (Don’t make the devil seem darker than he is.)

translation.src_text: Pa genyen pa gen gou.
translation.tgt_text: Being destitute is no fun.

src_text: Pa genyen pa gen gou. (Nothing beats having some flavor.)

translation.src_text: Pale anpil fè kont
translation.tgt_text: dispute

src_text: "Pale anpil fè kont" (Talking too much leads to conflict.)

translation.src_text: Pa gen kòd ki kapab mare dyab la.
translation.tgt_text: There's no taming the devil.

src_text: Pa gen kòd ki kapab mare dyab la. (No rope can tie up the devil.)

translation.src_text: Pa gen Tonton Nò, pa gen palmis.
translation.tgt_text: One goes with the other

src_text: Pa gen Tonton Nò, pa gen palmis. (No Tonton Nò, no palm trees.)

translation.src_text: Ipokrit se lizay.
translation.tgt_text: Hypocrisy is diplomacy.

src_text: Ipokrit se lizay. (Hypocrisy is just a disguise.)

translation.src_text: Gen konnen pase konnen
translation.tgt_text: Always more to learn

src_text: "Gen konnen pase konnen" (Sometimes, knowing too much can be worse than not knowing.)

translation.src_text: Gadyatè reskonsab
translation.tgt_text: The watchman is responsible

src_text: "Gadyatè reskonsab" (a responsible caretaker)

translation.src_text: Gen anpil dlo ki pou kouri ankò
translation.tgt_text: There is still a long way to go

src_text: "Gen anpil dlo ki pou kouri ankò" (There’s still a long way to go)

translation.src_text: Gen sòt pase sòt
translation.tgt_text: Degrees of foolishness exist

src_text: "Gen sòt pase sòt" (There are levels of foolishness)

translation.src_text: Gen koze, nanpwenn tan.
translation.tgt_text: Much to say, but no time to say it

src_text: Gen koze, nanpwenn tan. (There are things to be said, but not at just any time.)

translation.src_text: Gason se toujou gason
translation.tgt_text: A man is always a man.

src_text: "Gason se toujou gason" (A man is always a man)

translation.src_text: Gen kapab ak kapab,
translation.tgt_text: There's ability with ability

src_text: "Gen kapab ak kapab," (There’s a difference between being able and truly capable.)

translation.src_text: gen kapab pase kapab
translation.tgt_text: There is always a stronger power

src_text: gen kapab pase kapab (there are levels to this; being able is one thing, but surpassing it is another)

translation.src_text: Gade pa kreve je.
translation.tgt_text: Looking doesn't blind you.

src_text: Gade pa kreve je. (Looking doesn’t hurt anyone.)

translation.src_text: Gade pye bourik ou anvan ou chaje l
translation.tgt_text: Assess capability before assigning tasks

src_text: "Gade pye bourik ou anvan ou chaje l" (Make sure the donkey’s legs are strong before you load it.)

translation.src_text: Gade nan pa ou.
translation.tgt_text: Mind your own business

src_text: Gade nan pa ou. (Mind your own business.)

translation.src_text: Pa antre nan batay san baton.
translation.tgt_text: Don't ever enter into the battle without a stick/gun.

src_text: Pa antre nan batay san baton. (Don’t go into a fight without a stick.)

translation.src_text: Chak koukouy klere pou grenn je l
translation.tgt_text: Everyone for himself

src_text: Chak koukouy klere pou grenn je l (Everyone looks out for their own interests).

translation.src_text: Chak jou gen penn li.
translation.tgt_text: Sufficient unto each day is the evil thereof.

src_text: Chak jou gen penn li. (Every day has its own troubles.)

translation.src_text: Afè nèg se mistè.
translation.tgt_text: Private things are private.

src_text: Afè nèg se mistè. (A man’s business is a mystery.)

translation.src_text: Afè leta pa janm piti.
translation.tgt_text: State business isn't ever a small matter.

src_text: Afè leta pa janm piti. (Government matters are never small.)

translation.src_text: Ak laj yo vini saj.
translation.tgt_text: Wisdom comes with age

src_text: Ak laj yo vini saj. (With age comes wisdom.)

translation.src_text: Abondans byen pa nwi
translation.tgt_text: Great abundance doesn't hurt.

src_text: Abondans byen pa nwi (Having too much of a good thing doesn’t hurt)

translation.src_text: Afè nèg pa janm piti.
translation.tgt_text: One's own business is always of prime significance to him.

src_text: "Afè nèg pa janm piti." (A Black person's business is never small.)

translation.src_text: Ak labitid tout bagay posib.
translation.tgt_text: With proper habits, everything is possible.

src_text: Ak labitid tout bagay posib. (With habit, anything is possible.)

translation.src_text: Agawou di: si Bondye vle.
translation.tgt_text: Agaou says: if God so wills.

src_text: Agawou di: si Bondye vle. (As Agawou says: if God wills it.)

translation.src_text: Mal sele ka foule
translation.tgt_text: An inexperienced person can get into a lot of trouble.

src_text: Mal sele ka foule (A poorly saddled horse can still be ridden)

translation.src_text: Mal me ranje jen.
translation.tgt_text: April showers bring May flowers

src_text: "Mal me ranje jen." (Hard times shape youth.)

translation.src_text: Maladi ranje doktè
translation.tgt_text: Sickness fixes up/favors doctors

src_text: Maladi ranje doktè (Illness makes the doctor.)

translation.src_text: Madichon pa pè nan nwit.
translation.tgt_text: Badluck/evil spell isn't afraid at night.

src_text: Madichon pa pè nan nwit. (Curses are not afraid of the night.)

translation.src_text: Malè pa mal pou rive.
translation.tgt_text: Trouble comes so easily

src_text: "Malè pa mal pou rive." (Misfortune can happen to anyone.)

translation.src_text: Manje kwit pa gen mèt
translation.tgt_text: (The) cooked food has no owner/master

src_text: Manje kwit pa gen mèt (once food is cooked, it belongs to no one)

translation.src_text: Manmzèl pa pitimi san gadò
translation.tgt_text: This girl has some influential person behind her

src_text: "Manmzèl pa pitimi san gadò" (She’s not millet left without a shepherd; she’s not someone to be left unattended.)

translation.src_text: Mèt do pa grate do
translation.tgt_text: you always need someone to help you

src_text: "Mèt do pa grate do" (You scratch my back, I scratch yours)

translation.src_text: Mache chache pa janm dòmi san soupe.
translation.tgt_text: The one who's looking for something will find it

src_text: "Mache chache pa janm dòmi san soupe." (Those who go out hustling never go to bed hungry.)

translation.src_text: Maladi pran bouyon
translation.tgt_text: Things are going better for him.

src_text: Maladi pran bouyon (When you're sick, you need broth)

translation.src_text: Men pwont fè tout.
translation.tgt_text: A ready hand does everything

src_text: Men pwont fè tout. (A little bit of effort can do everything.)

translation.src_text: Malere pa dezonè
translation.tgt_text: Poverty is no disgrace.

src_text: "Malere pa dezonè" (Being poor is not dishonorable)

translation.src_text: Meprize vo mye pase reponn.
translation.tgt_text: To ignore someone is stronger than answering.

src_text: "Meprize vo mye pase reponn." (Sometimes it’s better to ignore than to respond.)

translation.src_text: Mèt kò pa grate kò
translation.tgt_text: You always need someone else to help you.

src_text: "Mèt kò pa grate kò" (You have to take care of yourself; no one else will do it for you)

translation.src_text: Maldjòk papa pa janm geri
translation.tgt_text: The curse of the parents is never eradicated

src_text: "Maldjòk papa pa janm geri" (A father’s curse never truly heals)

translation.src_text: Maladi pa tonbe sou pyebwa.
translation.tgt_text: People will always get sick.

src_text: Maladi pa tonbe sou pyebwa. (Illness doesn’t just fall from the sky.)

translation.src_text: Gade pa koute anyen
translation.tgt_text: Looking costs nothing.

src_text: Gade pa koute anyen (Looking is not the same as listening)

translation.src_text: Manje vyann, souse zo
translation.tgt_text: If you eat the meat, then you have to do it all, go all the way.

src_text: Manje vyann, souse zo (enjoy it to the fullest and get every last bit out of it)

translation.src_text: Yo kite moun onèt antre toupatou
translation.tgt_text: They let (the) honest man enter everywhere

src_text: Yo kite moun onèt antre toupatou (They let honest people go everywhere)

translation.src_text: Zanmorèt pa berejenn.
translation.tgt_text: Wild eggplant is not eggplant

src_text: "Zanmorèt pa berejenn." (A yam bean is not an eggplant.)

translation.src_text: Ou ap mande simityè si l bezwen mò!
translation.tgt_text: You don't have to ask me; you know I want it.

src_text: Ou ap mande simityè si l bezwen mò! (You’re asking the cemetery if it needs the dead!)

translation.src_text: Gen defen moun, pa gen defen travay.
translation.tgt_text: People die, but work never ends

src_text: "Gen defen moun, pa gen defen travay." (There are people who are irreplaceable, but no job is irreplaceable.)

translation.src_text: Vakabon se kòd gita
translation.tgt_text: If you touch him, he'll start trouble

src_text: Vakabon se kòd gita (A troublemaker is like the guitar string)

translation.src_text: Rann sèvis mennen chagren
translation.tgt_text: By trying to help, one becomes a victim.

src_text: Rann sèvis mennen chagren (Doing favors can bring trouble)

translation.src_text: Yon malè pa janm vini sèl.
translation.tgt_text: When it rains, it pours.

src_text: "Yon malè pa janm vini sèl." (Misfortune never comes alone.)

translation.src_text: Yo pa janm di defen kapon
translation.tgt_text: a dead person is a coward.

src_text: Yo pa janm di defen kapon (they never call the dead cowardly)

translation.src_text: Monchè, wè pa wè, n ap bat
translation.tgt_text: Whether we can see it or not, we will win

src_text: Monchè, wè pa wè, n ap bat (Man, whether we see it or not, we’re going to keep fighting).

translation.src_text: Merite pa mande
translation.tgt_text: He who deserves something doesn't ask for it.

src_text: Merite pa mande (What you deserve doesn’t need to be asked for)

translation.src_text: Youn mouri ak sa ki fè lòt viv
translation.tgt_text: One man's meat may be another's poison

src_text: "Youn mouri ak sa ki fè lòt viv" (One person’s death is another person’s livelihood.)

translation.src_text: Fè enpe, kite enpe
translation.tgt_text: Don't go to extremes.

src_text: Fè enpe, kite enpe (Do a little, leave a little)

translation.src_text: Fanm se chat
translation.tgt_text: Charm

src_text: Fanm se chat (Women are like cats)

translation.src_text: Fanm se kajou; li pa janm pèdi bonè l.
translation.tgt_text: Woman is mahogany; she doesn't ever lose her good chances

src_text: "Fanm se kajou; li pa janm pèdi bonè l." (A woman is like cashew fruit; she never loses her sweetness.)

translation.src_text: Fò ou jete pou ou ranmase.
translation.tgt_text: you reap what you sow

src_text: Fò ou jete pou ou ranmase. (You have to let go in order to gain.)

translation.src_text: Fye twòp twonpe, doute pa sèten.
translation.tgt_text: Overconfidence deceives; doubt is uncertain

src_text: "Fye twòp twonpe, doute pa sèten." (Too much pride can deceive you; doubt is not certainty.)

translation.src_text: Fanm se zanj; fanm se denmon
translation.tgt_text: Can't live with them,  can't live without them

src_text: "Fanm se zanj; fanm se denmon" (Women can be angels; women can be demons)

translation.src_text: Fanm se poto mitan.
translation.tgt_text: Women are backbone of the family and economy

src_text: Fanm se poto mitan. (Women are the backbone.)

translation.src_text: Fè koupe fè.
translation.tgt_text: Great needs demand great remedies

src_text: Fè koupe fè. (Fight fire with fire.)

translation.src_text: Fè kwa, men pa fè kwa poul
translation.tgt_text: Don't break your resolution.

src_text: Fè kwa, men pa fè kwa poul (Make the sign of the cross, but don’t make a chicken’s cross)

translation.src_text: Fè koute chè.
translation.tgt_text: Listening to others can be costly.

src_text: Fè koute chè. (It costs a lot.)

translation.src_text: Fanm se machandiz frajil.
translation.tgt_text: Handle women with care!

src_text: "Fanm se machandiz frajil." (Women are delicate goods.)

translation.src_text: Fè banda pa anpeche ou kouri pase tout moun.
translation.tgt_text: Being a big show-off doesn't prevent you from winning

src_text: Fè banda pa anpeche ou kouri pase tout moun. (Showing off doesn’t stop you from outrunning everybody.)

translation.src_text: Fè nèg byen, se bay Bondye.
translation.tgt_text: Do not necessarily expect to be rewarded on earth

src_text: Fè nèg byen, se bay Bondye. (Doing good to people is like giving to God.)

translation.src_text: Fizi tirè, nanpwenn aranjman
translation.tgt_text: You'd better not let the fight start, or it may be too late to negotiate!

src_text: "Fizi tirè, nanpwenn aranjman" (A shooter’s gun, no arrangement can fix it)

translation.src_text: Fè respè ou, ma fè pa m
translation.tgt_text: Show respect, yourself; I'll do the same.

src_text: Fè respè ou, ma fè pa m (You show me respect, and I’ll do my part)

translation.src_text: Fè tan, kitè tan
translation.tgt_text: You are strong today; you won't be tomorrow

src_text: "Fè tan, kitè tan" (Take your time; let time take its course.)

translation.src_text: Fè wè pa dire.
translation.tgt_text: A show-off doesn't last.

src_text: Fè wè pa dire. (Showing off doesn’t last.)

translation.src_text: Fè zanmi ak kouto avan zabriko mi.
translation.tgt_text: Make friends with a person while he's available

src_text: Fè zanmi ak kouto avan zabriko mi. (Make friends with the knife before the apricot ripens.)

translation.src_text: Flè toujou nouvèl
translation.tgt_text: Always fresh in appearance

src_text: Flè toujou nouvèl (A flower is always new)

translation.src_text: Flèch palmis pa fizi
translation.tgt_text: Appearances can be deceptive

src_text: Flèch palmis pa fizi (A palm arrow is not a gun)

translation.src_text: Fò kou ou fò, ou a jwenn mèt ou.
translation.tgt_text: However strong you may be, you will meet your match.

src_text: "Fò kou ou fò, ou a jwenn mèt ou." (No matter how strong you are, you’ll eventually meet your match.)

translation.src_text: Fòk bay tan tan
translation.tgt_text: Patience is necessary

src_text: "Fòk bay tan tan" (You have to give it time)

translation.src_text: Fòk ou simen pou ou rekòlte.
translation.tgt_text: Effort and preparation are necessary for success

src_text: Fòk ou simen pou ou rekòlte. (You have to sow before you can reap.)

translation.src_text: Fòk fèy zòrèy ou pa pi long pase tèt ou.
translation.tgt_text: Don't listen to gossip

src_text: Fòk fèy zòrèy ou pa pi long pase tèt ou. (Don’t let your ears stick out farther than your head.)

translation.src_text: Fòk gen maladi pou gen lanmò
translation.tgt_text: Death is a natural consequence of illness

src_text: "Fòk gen maladi pou gen lanmò" (There has to be sickness before there can be death)

translation.src_text: Bourik mèt mete chapo, se pou de zorèy-li parèt.
translation.tgt_text: You can’t hide your true origins.

src_text: Bourik mèt mete chapo, se pou de zorèy-li parèt. (If a donkey wears a hat, its two ears will still show.)

translation.src_text: Lè nen pran kou, se je ki kouri dlo.
translation.tgt_text: Sometimes you suffer because of what someone else does.

src_text: Lè nen pran kou, se je ki kouri dlo. (When the nose gets hit, the eyes start tearing up.)

translation.src_text: Aprè dans, tambou lou.
translation.tgt_text: Good times leave behind problems, and those who give advice don’t deal with the mess.

src_text: Aprè dans, tambou lou. (After the dance, the drum feels heavy.)

translation.src_text: Se rat kay kap manje pay kay.
translation.tgt_text: Trouble often comes from inside, not outside.

src_text: Se rat kay kap manje pay kay. (It’s the house rat that eats the house’s straw.)

translation.src_text: Bosi pa bwè kokoye kanpe.
translation.tgt_text: You’ve got to adapt to your situation

src_text: "Bosi pa bwè kokoye kanpe." (A fool doesn’t drink coconut water standing up.)

translation.src_text: Touttan ou sòti pi wo ou pran pi gwo so.
translation.tgt_text: When powerful people fall, it’s always brutal.

src_text: "Touttan ou sòti pi wo ou pran pi gwo so." (The higher you start, the bigger the leap you have to take.)

translation.src_text: Fok ou chache konn chemen avan ou pran rout pou ou kouri.
translation.tgt_text: Plan ahead if you want to make it.

src_text: "Fok ou chache konn chemen avan ou pran rout pou ou kouri." (You need to know the road before you start running.)

translation.src_text: Ti pwason swiv kouran.
translation.tgt_text: People are shaped by the world around them.

src_text: "Ti pwason swiv kouran." (Small fish follow the current.)

translation.src_text: Ou chita sou po bèf-la wap pale-l mal.
translation.tgt_text: The ungrateful insult the very ones who help them.

src_text: Ou chita sou po bèf-la wap pale-l mal. (You’re sitting on the cow’s hide and still talking bad about it.)

translation.src_text: Bon bouch ap pale, move zorèy ap koute.
translation.tgt_text: Be careful what you say, because some folks twist your words.

src_text: "Bon bouch ap pale, move zorèy ap koute." (Good words are spoken, but bad ears are the ones listening.)

translation.src_text: Piti pa janm grandi anba gwo
translation.tgt_text: The strong always win, the weak stay small.

src_text: Piti pa janm grandi anba gwo (small things never grow under something bigger)

translation.src_text: Menne koulèv lekol se youn, men fèl chita se de.
translation.tgt_text: Saying something is easy, proving it is harder.

src_text: "Menne koulèv lekol se youn, men fèl chita se de." (Bringing a snake to school is one thing, but making it sit still is another.)

translation.src_text: Foumi pa janm mouri anba barik siro.
translation.tgt_text: However small, a woman can still take care of her family.

src_text: Foumi pa janm mouri anba barik siro. (Ants never die under a barrel of syrup.)

translation.src_text: Lagè avèti pa tye kokobe.
translation.tgt_text: Being prepared saves you

src_text: "Lagè avèti pa tye kokobe." (A warning before war can save the crippled.)

translation.src_text: ete pa janm trò lou pou mèt-li kouri
translation.tgt_text: Everyone has to carry their own load in life.

src_text: "ete pa janm trò lou pou mèt-li kouri" (never let the burden be too heavy for the one who has to carry it)

translation.src_text: Kou toti wè lajan, li vire soudo.
translation.tgt_text: People will do anything for money

src_text: "Kou toti wè lajan, li vire soudo." (As soon as a turtle sees money, it turns greedy.)

translation.src_text: Saki nan kè yanm se kouto ki konnenn.
translation.tgt_text: Everyone carries secrets no one else can see.

src_text: Saki nan kè yanm se kouto ki konnenn. (Only the knife knows what’s inside the yam.)

translation.src_text: Tro prese pakab fè jou rive
translation.tgt_text: you can’t force time

src_text: "Tro prese pakab fè jou rive" (Rushing too much can't make the day come any faster)

translation.src_text: Tro prese pakab fè jou rive
translation.tgt_text: patience wins.

src_text: "Tro prese pakab fè jou rive" (Rushing too much can’t make the day come any faster)

translation.src_text: Wi pa monte mòn.
translation.tgt_text: Saying it doesn’t mean doing it

src_text: Wi pa monte mòn. (Yes doesn’t climb mountains.)

translation.src_text: Chen mete de pat-li nan lestomak moun li konnen, si non se baton ka korije-l.
translation.tgt_text: Don’t act too familiar with strangers, it’ll backfire.

src_text: "Chen mete de pat-li nan lestomak moun li konnen, si non se baton ka korije-l." (A dog puts both paws on the chest of someone it knows; otherwise, only a stick can set it straight.)

translation.src_text: Lenj sal lave an fanmi
translation.tgt_text: don’t put your business out there

src_text: Lenj sal lave an fanmi (family matters are best handled within the family)

translation.src_text: Chita pa bay
translation.tgt_text: don’t be lazy, get up and do something

src_text: "Chita pa bay" (Sitting around doesn’t get you anywhere.)

translation.src_text: Tann jis nou tounen pwa tann
translation.tgt_text: to wait forever.

src_text: Tann jis nou tounen pwa tann (Wait until we turn into dried peas)

translation.src_text: Yon sèl dwèt pa manje kalalou
translation.tgt_text: work together

src_text: "Yon sèl dwèt pa manje kalalou" (One finger can’t eat okra; you need help from others.)

translation.src_text: Remèsi chen se kout baton
translation.tgt_text: a good deed that’s not appreciated

src_text: Remèsi chen se kout baton (Showing gratitude to a dog can get you bitten)

translation.src_text: Renmen tout, pèdi tout
translation.tgt_text: Don’t be greedy

src_text: "Renmen tout, pèdi tout" (Love everyone, lose everything)

translation.src_text: Jou fèy la tonbe nan dlo a se pa jou sa li pouri
translation.tgt_text: Be patient, no matter what you do the results will come

src_text: "Jou fèy la tonbe nan dlo a se pa jou sa li pouri" (A leaf doesn’t rot the day it falls into the water.)

translation.src_text: Bat chen an tann mèt li
translation.tgt_text: be careful, if you hurt someone, someone else close to them will come after you

src_text: Bat chen an tann mèt li (Wait until the owner comes for the dog)

translation.src_text: Malè avèti pa tiye kokobe
translation.tgt_text: be careful, it’s a warning, there will be danger, stay away so you don’t get hurt

src_text: "Malè avèti pa tiye kokobe" (A warning of trouble doesn’t kill the crippled man)

translation.src_text: Pa Pete nan koton bay santi
translation.tgt_text: to ignore someone

src_text: Pa Pete nan koton bay santi (Don’t do something sneaky and expect it not to show)

translation.src_text: Yon sèl dwèt pa manje kalalou
translation.tgt_text: one person cannot do everything

src_text: "Yon sèl dwèt pa manje kalalou" (You can’t do it alone; one finger can’t eat okra)

translation.src_text: Kay koule twonpe solèy, men li pa twonpe lapli
translation.tgt_text: you can’t trick everyone or hide all your mistakes at least not forever

src_text: "Kay koule twonpe solèy, men li pa twonpe lapli" (A leaky roof may fool the sun, but it won’t fool the rain.)

translation.src_text: Pa gen nen nan figi
translation.tgt_text: having no shame

src_text: Pa gen nen nan figi (there’s no nose on the face)

translation.src_text: Se mèt kò ki veye kò
translation.tgt_text: you are responsible for your own life and your own stuff

src_text: Se mèt kò ki veye kò (you’ve got to look out for yourself)

translation.src_text: Pousyè mache pi bon pase pousyè chita
translation.tgt_text: don’t sit around and do nothing, get up and find something to do

src_text: "Pousyè mache pi bon pase pousyè chita" (Dust that moves is better than dust that sits still)

translation.src_text: Sa ki pa touye ou ap angrese ou
translation.tgt_text: if it doesn’t kill you, it will make you stronger

src_text: Sa ki pa touye ou ap angrese ou (What doesn’t kill you makes you stronger.)

translation.src_text: Pitit tig se tig
translation.tgt_text: if someone is mean their kids are likely to be mean

src_text: "Pitit tig se tig" (Like father, like son)

translation.src_text: Ou ka fè bourik janbe dlo ou pa ka fè l bwè dlo
translation.tgt_text: You can’t make people do whatever you want

src_text: Ou ka fè bourik janbe dlo ou pa ka fè l bwè dlo (You can make a donkey cross the water, but you can’t make it drink it)
